e5_2: Agent proposes a missing BF relation, acquisition and executable observation; no supplied expression

real_consumer_boundary.adapter_status: NOT_REGISTERED; requires S0/kernel integration in a later feature
real_consumer_boundary.causal_benefit: requires a separate frozen with/without-observation comparison; schema acceptance alone proves no gain
real_consumer_boundary.dataflow: qualified relation artifact -> typed parameter/constraint -> real BF consumer input -> execution -> independent service check
real_consumer_boundary.trust: external kernel registry; participant-supplied registry or self-declared actor is insufficient

stages.falsifier: researcher supplied target fields or expression
requires: proposed BF relation and applicability domain

stages.falsifier: unsupported domain or observation that cannot distinguish the proposed relation
advice or an unbound value presented as measurement
self-check only, evaluator leakage or post-outcome tuning
requires: uninformative, tampered, out-of-domain and static-rich controls

stages.falsifier: echo, log-only use, scoring receipt or self-signed consumer receipt
requires: observation input edge and execution hash

stages.falsifier: current-task repair relabeled transfer or recursion
requires: outcome-blind next BF judgment or design decision

validator_boundary: structural admission against external authority, not execution or behavioral proof
